top_signals.title: Japan PM Takaichi Denies She’s Driving Weak Yen, High Rates
top_signals.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi strongly denied the notion that she’s responsible for a weak yen and high interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: As obstacles to peace go, Zelenskyy ranks below Trump
top_signals.summary: In the hierarchy of politicians responsible for the continuation of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Zelenskyy ranks only third, after Putin and Trump.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Indonesian Stocks Tumble to Lowest Since 2020 After MSCI Warning
top_signals.summary: Indonesian stocks extended their selloff, deepening their worst rout in almost 30 years after MSCI Inc. warned that the country risks losing its emerging-market status, fueling fears of worsening foreign capital outflows.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
